meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装、发现和编排 HyperFrames 组件块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 HyperFrames 构建组合式前端应用
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames registry blocks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build composable frontend apps with HyperFrames

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能执行 HyperFrames 注册表操作：安装一个块/组件或按标签安装所有匹配的块、用 catalog 浏览、把块接线到 index.html、处理 hyperframes.json 配置，并按模板新建块/组件。
howto.when: 当你运行 hyperframes add 或 hyperframes catalog 命令，或需要把已安装的块接进 index.html、处理 hyperframes.json 时。

say.text: 安装 captions 标签下的所有块
say.note: Claude 会运行 add 并告知写入的文件和粘贴代码

say.text: 用 hyperframes catalog 看看有哪些组件
把 data-chart 块接进主合成，开始时间 2 秒
say.note: 会给出带必需属性的 HTML 片段

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can run HyperFrames registry operations: install a single block/component or all blocks by tag, browse with catalog, wire blocks into index.html, handle hyperframes.json, and scaffold new blocks/components from templates.
howto.when_en: When you run hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, or need to wire an installed block into index.html or work with hyperframes.json.

say_en.note: Claude will run add and list the files written.

say_en.text: Wire the data-chart block into the host, start at 2s
say_en.note: Claude will give the required HTML snippet.
